name: Nautilus
description: The Winterworks nautilus mount in the vanilla mob style: a chunky stepped coil of a shell in cream with rust stripes radiating from a dark navel button, a blotched brown hood, small flat dot eyes on stubby bulbs, eight short ringed tentacles, a siphon funnel and a sea-teal saddle the renderer can hide. Minecraft pixel units, density 1: exports 1:1 to a vanilla entity model.
